[ActiveMember_Alex]: Follow-up on the sync issue and PUSH_QUEUE_STALLED:

Support replied to my ticket and confirmed there’s a known bug in 5.2.1 where the desktop push queue can stall if mobile deltas arrive in a certain order. Their workaround for now is:
- Desktop: Sign out/in once to clear the queue.
- Then disable "Aggressive background sync" under Settings → Sync → Advanced.
They also said a fix is planned for 5.2.2. After turning that option off, my mobile edits started appearing on desktop without needing to sign out/in. Feel free to point others here if they hit the same warnings.

rounds.response:
Mark — yes, please state in the ticket that you already reindexed/rebuilt the local cache and include the client’s “Fully synced” status, example note titles/timestamps, and the desktop sync/search logs so engineering doesn’t repeat basic repro steps.  
Lily — Team workspaces centralize billing and workspace‑level ownership, but you can keep truly personal notebooks by not adding them to the Team workspace (or keeping them in a separate personal account); always export personal notebooks before migrating/leaving and confirm offboarding/export options with support.  
Jade — renaming a shared notebook requires owner/admin rights; check Notebook → Info or Sharing to see the owner/admins, ask an admin to rename or grant you “Manage” permission, and if that’s unclear or you keep getting the error open a support ticket with the notebook ID and the permission error logs.

rounds.response: Eli — try toggling airplane mode to reset the cellular radio, confirm SyncPro has unrestricted background data and "Sync over cellular" enabled (and that system Data Saver/carrier limits aren’t active), whitelist the app in device battery/Doze/manufacturer power settings, then test and note slow-sync timestamps; if it persists, send mobile sync logs/diagnostics (Help → Send diagnostics) with those timestamps to support. Priya — make sure your CSV header is exactly "tags" and the cell uses the app’s expected separator (try semicolons, e.g. "work;urgent", or comma‑separated values inside quotes), or export a small notebook from SyncPro to examine the exact tag format and mimic that. If either approach fails, attach a one‑row sample CSV, your app version/OS, and relevant logs to your ticket and I’ll help escalate.
